title: Where are you from?
instructions: İki öğrenci dil kursunun ilk gününde tanışıyor. Ülke, şehir ve dillere dikkat et.

script.speaker: pablo
script.text: Hi, I'm Pablo. Is this your first day too?

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Yes, it is. I'm Yuki. Nice to meet you.

script.speaker: pablo
script.text: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: I'm from Japan, from Kyoto. And you?

script.speaker: pablo
script.text: I'm from Mexico. I live in Mexico City.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Do you speak any other languages?

script.speaker: pablo
script.text: Spanish, of course, and a little French.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: I speak Japanese and a little Chinese.

questions.prompt: What other language does Pablo speak a little?
What other language does Yuki speak a little?
